component.name: FreeSynergy.Packages
component.summary: Install, update and remove FreeSynergy programs, frontends, components and themes

description.p: FreeSynergy Packages: install, update and remove FreeSynergy programs, frontends, components and themes. Everything comes from signed catalogs and is checked against the project key before it is installed; a failed update is rolled back.

FreeSynergy Packages: Programme, Frontends, Komponenten und Themes von FreeSynergy installieren, aktualisieren und entfernen. Alles stammt aus signierten Katalogen und wird vor der Installation gegen den Projektschlüssel geprüft; ein fehlgeschlagenes Update wird zurückgerollt.
Plan what has to be done: lists, status and Kanban views, due dates, relations between tasks, and import and export as iCalendar. Your tasks stay in your own data folder.
Your people and contacts: cards with names, mail, phone and notes, groups of people, and vCard import and export. Everything stays in your own data folder.

Plan your days: a window with month, week, day and an overview of events, shown in this preview with example data. The core (events with times and zones, repeating events, import and export as iCalendar) is not wired to the window yet. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

Your files in one place, kept under their real names: folders, files, upload and download, rename, move, copy, trash and restore, and storage places. Pictures are listed as a gallery facet. What is not built yet is shown and says so.

Texts that belong together: pages in a tree with links and backlinks, search, and import and export of Markdown. The window opens editable; pages can be made, renamed, deleted and saved there. Your texts stay in your own data folder.
Your groups: create, rename, set the kind of and delete groups in a window; nesting, members and invitations are in the program core. Works alone, no directory server needed.
Your places as lists and sheets. A first version: there is no map view yet, only the lists and the sheet of each place.

component.name: FreeSynergy.Draw
component.summary: An endless board for ideas, drawings and diagrams

description.p: An endless board for ideas: shapes, text, arrows and drawings that several people can change at once without a referee. This first version is a window with its server that says plainly what works today and what comes; the engine behind it (boards, pages, merging, undo, SVG export) is not wired to the window yet, so nothing can be drawn there. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

component.name: FreeSynergy.Messages
component.summary: Mail, chat and AI agents in one place, encrypted only

description.p: Say something to someone: mail, chat and AI agents in one program, and a message is only sent if it can be sent encrypted. This first version is a window with its server that says plainly what works today and what comes; the core (message model, encrypted-only sending, mail and Matrix connectors, AI guard) is not wired to the window yet. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

component.name: FreeSynergy.Forms
component.summary: Surveys where an anonymous answer really is anonymous

description.p: Ask questions, collect answers and read the result: named or anonymous, where anonymous answers are kept in a separate box with no log and no time, and results appear only for a minimum group size. This first version is a window with its server that says plainly what works today and what comes; the core (surveys, ballots, results, counting methods, CSV export) is not connected to the window yet, so no survey can be made there. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

component.name: FreeSynergy.Activities
component.summary: What happened in your programs: one local timeline, newest first

description.p: See what happened in your programs: a timeline of activities as short summaries, never the content, kept local and yours. This first version is a window with its server that says plainly what works today and what comes; the core (timeline, filters, summaries, forgetting) is not wired to the window yet. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

component.name: FreeSynergy.Resources
component.summary: Things, rooms, material and time: what we have and need

description.p: Know what a group has and needs: things, rooms and material, and who may use them when. This first version is a window with its server that says plainly what works today and what comes; the core (reservations that cannot overbook, free time, needs and offers, your own capacity) is not connected to the window yet, so nothing can be managed in it. What is not built yet is shown and says so. Contract: draft.

component.name: Zentinel
component.summary: Reverse proxy with TLS, routing and rate limits

description.p: The Zentinel reverse proxy (Apache-2.0), mirrored and signed by FreeSynergy: TLS termination, routing by host and path, load balancing, health checks, rate limiting and reload while running. It installs as a system service that is not switched on by itself.

Der Reverse-Proxy Zentinel (Apache-2.0), gespiegelt und signiert von FreeSynergy: TLS-Abschluss, Routing nach Host und Pfad, Lastverteilung, Gesundheitsprüfung, Ratenbegrenzung und Neuladen im Betrieb. Er wird als Systemdienst installiert, der nicht von selbst eingeschaltet wird.
